meta.name: Luxe Hair Studio
meta.description: Luxury hairdressing salon single-page app with a scroll-scrubbed transformation hero, service menu, before/after gallery, stylist matchmaker, AI consultation, booking, sensory salon, concierge and the Atelier Console.
meta.warning: The recovery artifact is luxe-rebuild-paste.txt (all sources byte-for-byte). The compiled deployable site is luxe-compiled-site.zip. Both are emitted by vite on every build.
meta.recovery: Paste luxe-rebuild-paste.txt into the chat, then npm install && npm run build.

features: Scroll-scrubbed transformation hero (4 stages, title cards, progress rail, letterbox, grain)
Service menu with category filters + signature packages
Atelier Console (Customizer): design/content/sections/system, 5 presets, localStorage persistence
Light/dark theme, custom cursor, preloader, reduced-motion support

artifacts.note: Serve the unzipped compiled site over http (npx serve). Do not open index.html from file://.
